svg.title: Gaussian heat-flow density and SDE versus ODE paths
svg.desc: Left: exact normalized Gaussian densities widen as variance v0+2*kappa*t grows. Right: four common Gaussian initial draws; solid lines connect exact finite-grid Brownian samples; dashed curves are deterministic ODE paths. A forward ODE arrow at positive state points outward. Horizontal time and state axes use declared coordinate units; this is a finite model calculation, not a trained generator.
